# Understanding

- Existing pipeline reporting lacks required granularity, making it difficult to accurately track lead progress and monitor ROI on marketing efforts.
- Integrated Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) insights are currently unavailable, limiting visibility into customer journey expenses and marketing effectiveness.
- There is a need to connect and ingest data from QuickBooks, which is not yet integrated, complicating accurate CAC calculation.
- Assessing the quality of ingested data is necessary to ensure reliability and accuracy in CAC and Lead-to-AUM (L2A) reporting.
- Enhanced L2A and CAC data models are required to provide more detailed insights into the conversion journey and allocation of marketing spend.
- Automated data ingestion and transformation pipelines are needed to support timely, batch-processed reporting in the Fabric platform.
- The new reporting solution must be accessible to data and technology stakeholders, senior leadership, and marketing teams.
- Mandatory integrations include Salesforce and QuickBooks to support unified reporting and analytics.
- User requirements focus on leveraging Power BI for comprehensive, automated dashboards providing actionable L2A and CAC metrics.
